derivation:
simpa [tensorCoordinateLinearEquiv] using
  TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft_apply_tmul_apply (N := M) b c m i
explanation: Mathlib's `TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft_apply_tmul_apply` states `(equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft ℬ) (m ⊗ₜ n) i = ℬ.repr m i • n` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Basis.lean:139). The library's `tensorCoordinateLinearEquiv R C M b` is by definition `equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft b ≪≫ₗ Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite R M ι`, and the coefficient map of `linearEquivFunOnFinite` is the identity coercion on functions, so applying it needs only unfolding; `tensorGenerator R C M c m` is definitionally `c ⊗ₜ[R] m` (`tensorGenerator_apply` is `rfl`, and it is `@[simp]`). Hence the target is exactly the Mathlib lemma after unfolding these two local transparent definitions, in the same generality (the target's `[Finite ι]` setting supplies `DecidableEq ι` classically, which is all the Mathlib lemma needs). The library's own proof does not invoke the Mathlib declaration: it goes through `tensorGenerator_apply` and the library lemma `tensorCoordinateLinearEquiv_tmul_apply` (itself proved by `simp` from the Mathlib equivalence API).
